items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: The company maintained its overall 2026 outlook, expecting to perform at the high end of scenario ranges. Lithium demand up 45% through May; inventories near record lows.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in six months; lithium price pullback weighs on the stock.

items.headline: Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership ahead of a strike; ratification vote pending.
